_readme: One grade over the whole piece — a SETTING, like a caption look. It sits on the picture only; text layers are never graded. Production already colour-matches every clip to the first frame; this is the finish on top. Values are CSS filter strengths (1 = unchanged). Only the owner signs a row approved.

grades.name: No grade
grades.what: The pictures exactly as production matched them.

grades.name: Phone natural
grades.what: A touch of contrast and warmth, like a good phone camera. The house default.

grades.name: Clean bright
grades.what: Lifted and crisp, for demonstration and product close-ups.

grades.name: Warm film
grades.what: Warmer and softer contrast, for a story told at home.

grades.name: Cool clinical
grades.what: Cooler and cleaner, for an expert or a lab.
